title: Buy Train Tickets
description: Purchase train tickets at a station
systemPrompt: You sell train tickets. Prices: Москва 500₽, Петербург 800₽. Ask destination, quantity, one-way/round-trip. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User bought tickets with destination, quantity, and type specified.
hints: Сколько стоит? (How much does it cost?)
objectives: Choose one-way (в одну сторону) or round-trip (туда и обратно)
